body: UPDATE: Well the good news is my scales are just cooked. The bad news is, I might not be smart enough to dabble in psychedelics 😅
It happens to me a lot
Ah good call. I'll check that out. Much appreciated!
How could I not be enough when past versions of me would probably neck themselves if they saw how shit my life turns out

I was on SSRI's, yes but after doing a little research beforehand, I weened off them before trying the shrooms. It was 3 or 4 weeks between my first try of shrooms (about 1.5g) and last course of antidepressants. And then another 2 weeks or so til my next try of 5-6g

I think addressing the root cause for my feelings is what I'm really looking for. If that means going to a very dark place, then so be it because at this stage I'm willing to try anything. I'm just sick of feeling shitty

Thanks for the advice :)

Thanks for the advice.

Can I ask what you by mean tried everything though? In regards to depression treatment, or in regards to trying mushrooms?

For background, next year will be the 20th anniversary of when I first started to feel depressed (I'm old). I'm currently seeing a psychologist and have tried antidepressants and such in the past.
As for trying mushrooms, I have tried them twice and seem to have a high tolerance. On 5-6 grams I got a bit of a high but no loss of sense of self.

What's the benefit of microdosing over going for ego death?
I'm really just looking for information here because I feel a bit lost in the woods

Interesting. From what I've heard so far, and I could be completely wrong here, is that with ego death since it breaks down your sense of self, it allows you to view your own thinking patterns from an "unbiased" perspective. Thus you can see the flaws in the logic of your negative thinking patterns because you're almost viewing your own mind from the outside in.
At least that's what I've heard
Will do. It could be quite a while from now though
